findings.current: You’ve all just fought monsters, so your mana fatigue is severe.
findings.defect: The pronouns incorrectly assign the severe mana fatigue to the people being addressed rather than to the mages explaining why they cannot cast Teleport.
findings.rationale: The mage is describing the condition of the group of mages denoted by 다들; this condition is part of their explanation for being unable to cast Teleport.
findings.replacement: We’ve all just fought monsters, so our mana fatigue is severe.
findings.source: 다들 몬스터를 상대한 직후라 마나 피로도가 극심한 데다가

findings.defect: The place name is romanized inconsistently with the established term and its other occurrences in the chapter.
The translation drops “Magic” from Magic Johnson’s established name, obscuring the specific reference and its wordplay in a discussion of exceptional magic.
findings.rationale: 매직 존슨 explicitly names Magic Johnson, the dark-skinned Grand Mage described in the following sentence.

findings.current: More than half of the twenty-two Hunters, including himself and Kim Hwajong, had met gruesome deaths.
findings.defect: The placement of “including himself and Kim Hwajong” makes it read as though both living characters are included among those who died.
findings.rationale: The source includes Choi Minwoo and Kim Hwajong in the original total of twenty-two Hunters, not among the dead.
findings.replacement: Of the twenty-two Hunters—including himself and Kim Hwajong—more than half had met gruesome deaths.
findings.source: 그렇게 자신과 김화종을 포함한 스물두 명의 헌터 중 절반이 넘는 인원이 처참한 죽음을 맞이했다.

findings.current: The blood blocking his vision was red, and the swords in both of Choi Minwoo’s hands radiated a pure white brilliance.
findings.defect: The translation changes one sword held with both hands into multiple swords, one in each hand.
findings.rationale: 검은 is singular in context, while 양손에 들린 states that Choi Minwoo is holding that sword with both hands.
findings.replacement: The blood blocking his vision was red, and the sword Choi Minwoo held in both hands radiated a pure white brilliance.
findings.source: 시야를 가로막는 핏물은 붉었고, 최민우의 양손에 들린 검은 새하얀 광휘를 내뿜었다.

summary: Five actionable findings: two subject/action ambiguities, one altered weapon quantity, one omitted name element, and one inconsistent place-name romanization.
